poison_swallowed.text: This is urgent. Call emergency services or a local poison help line now, or ask a trusted adult to call. I cannot diagnose poisoning, and you should not wait for a chat answer before getting help.

bleeding.text: This is urgent. Call emergency services or a trusted adult now. I cannot diagnose the bleeding, and you should get real help immediately instead of waiting for a chat answer.

fainting.text: This may be urgent. Sit or lie down somewhere safe and call a trusted adult or emergency services now. I cannot diagnose fainting, and I should not delay real help.

breathing_chest_pain.text: This sounds urgent. Call emergency services or a trusted adult now. Trouble breathing or chest pain needs real help, not a local diagnosis from me.
